findings.title: PLO refugee affairs official says more than 3,000 UNRWA Gaza staff received notices to switch from permanent to three-month contracts
findings.publisher: Palestine News and Information Agency (WAFA), reporting a Palestine Liberation Organization Department of Refugee Affairs statement
findings.affected_population_system: More than 3,000 reported UNRWA Gaza employees, their households and potential future continuity of refugee health, education and relief services
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The Palestine Liberation Organization's (PLO) Department of Refugee Affairs on Sunday warned of the implications of UNRWA management's move to notify more than 3,000 employees in the Gaza Strip, each with less than 13 years of service, that they are required to sign temporary three-month contracts.
findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency relaying an on-record PLO department statement; no direct UNRWA confirmation
findings.summary: The PLO Department of Refugee Affairs says UNRWA notified over 3,000 Gaza employees with under 13 years of service to change permanent contracts into three-month contracts. Its official Ahmad Abu Holi warns of potential nonrenewal and harm to health, education and relief capacity. This is a reported employment-contract change with possible future humanitarian-service consequences, NOT verified layoffs, service closures, or demonstrated healthcare disruption. Independent UNRWA confirmation was unavailable.
